independent_outcomes: waves.diff_files returns the real repo-relative path for Git-quoted diff headers (non-ASCII, double quote, backslash, tab), and a malformed quoted header is skipped without raising.
proposed_seams: No split proposed. The brief is one defect in one function (the header parser at template/src/pdca_harness/waves.py:329-332). Legs (a)-(f) all test that one parser, and leg (e) only checks the overlap audit because the audit reads diff_files.

The callers (_audit_wave_overlap, size_signal patch_files, size-calibrate) change behaviour only because the parser now returns more paths. They do not need their own fix, so they are not a separate outcome. If the human wants them kept apart, the one possible seam is leg (e) as a follow-up PR, but it would fail until the parser fix lands, so it is not independent.
